'''Kouvar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Voss]], where he was injured and asked an Imperial-allied individual to deal with the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] chief [[Raklann]].
